generated.as: int4range(extract(epoch from start_time)::integer, extract(epoch from end_time)::integer, '[)')

chk_payment_target.name: chk_payment_target
chk_payment_target.value: ("payments"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("payments"."registration_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_matchmaking_requests_type_shape.name: chk_matchmaking_requests_type_shape
chk_matchmaking_requests_type_shape.value:
(
    ("matchmaking_requests"."match_type" = 'SINGLES' AND "matchmaking_requests"."capacity" = 2 AND "matchmaking_requests"."min_players" = 2 AND "matchmaking_requests"."companion_count" = 0)
    OR ("matchmaking_requests"."match_type" = 'DOUBLES' AND "matchmaking_requests"."capacity" = 4 AND "matchmaking_requests"."min_players" = 4 AND "matchmaking_requests"."companion_count" = 0)
    OR ("matchmaking_requests"."match_type" = 'GROUP' AND "matchmaking_requests"."capacity" BETWEEN 3 AND 20 AND "matchmaking_requests"."min_players" BETWEEN 2 AND "matchmaking_requests"."capacity" AND 1 + "matchmaking_requests"."companion_count" <= "matchmaking_requests"."capacity")
  )

chk_matchmaking_requests_external_court.name: chk_matchmaking_requests_external_court
chk_matchmaking_requests_external_court.value:
(
    ("matchmaking_requests"."external_court_name" IS NULL AND "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_city" IS NULL AND "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_district" IS NULL AND "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_address" IS NULL)
    OR ("matchmaking_requests"."external_court_name" IS NOT NULL AND "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_city" IS NOT NULL AND "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_district" IS NOT NULL AND "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_address" IS NOT NULL)
  )

chk_matchmaking_requests_court_consisten.name: chk_matchmaking_requests_court_consistency
chk_matchmaking_requests_court_consisten.value: "matchmaking_requests"."booking_id" IS NULL OR "matchmaking_requests"."external_court_name" IS NULL OR "matchmaking_requests"."court_same_venue_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL

chk_report_target.name: chk_report_target
chk_report_target.value:
(
      (CASE WHEN "reports"."reported_player_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN "reports"."reported_facility_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN "reports"."reported_tournament_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN "reports"."reported_post_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN "reports"."reported_comment_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN "reports"."reported_message_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) = 1

chk_report_attachment_requires_message.name: chk_report_attachment_requires_message
chk_report_attachment_requires_message.value: "reports"."reported_attachment_id" IS NULL OR "reports"."reported_message_id" IS NOT NULL

chk_owner_review_target.name: chk_owner_review_target
chk_owner_review_target.value: ("court_owner_reviews"."facility_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("court_owner_reviews"."court_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_owner_review_kind.name: chk_owner_review_kind
chk_owner_review_kind.value: "court_owner_reviews"."kind" IN ('ONBOARDING', 'ADDRESS_CHANGE') AND ("court_owner_reviews"."kind" <> 'ADDRESS_CHANGE' OR "court_owner_reviews"."facility_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_owner_review_decision.name: chk_owner_review_decision
chk_owner_review_decision.value: ("court_owner_reviews"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "court_owner_reviews"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "court_owner_reviews"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "court_owner_reviews"."rejection_reason" IS NULL) OR ("court_owner_reviews"."status" = 'APPROVED' AND "court_owner_reviews"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "court_owner_reviews"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "court_owner_reviews"."rejection_reason" IS NULL) OR ("court_owner_reviews"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "court_owner_reviews"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "court_owner_reviews"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "court_owner_reviews"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("court_owner_reviews"."rejection_reason")) > 0)

posts_feed_idx.name: posts_feed_idx
posts_feed_idx.where: "posts"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "posts"."hidden_at" IS NULL

chk_conversations_title.name: chk_conversations_title
chk_conversations_title.value: ("conversations"."type" = 'GROUP' AND "conversations"."title" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("conversations"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120) OR ("conversations"."type" = 'DIRECT' AND "conversations"."title" IS NULL)

chk_conversations_direct_cols.name: chk_conversations_direct_cols
chk_conversations_direct_cols.value: ("conversations"."type" = 'DIRECT' AND "conversations"."direct_user_low_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_high_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_low_id" < "conversations"."direct_user_high_id") OR ("conversations"."type" = 'GROUP' AND "conversations"."direct_user_low_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_high_id" IS NULL)

chk_player_skill_surveys_components.name: chk_player_skill_surveys_components
chk_player_skill_surveys_components.value: "player_skill_surveys"."score_k" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."score_r" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."score_x" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."score_p" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."score_a" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."score_t" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

chk_player_skill_surveys_scores.name: chk_player_skill_surveys_scores
chk_player_skill_surveys_scores.value: "player_skill_surveys"."raw_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."final_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "player_skill_surveys"."final_score" <= "player_skill_surveys"."raw_score"
